subject: a tall stack of three thick, fluffy buttermilk pancakes topped with whipped cream, glossy cubes of roasted purple sweet potato, a piped rosette of pale violet sweet potato mousse, a drizzle of honey and a dusting of cinnamon
hero_ko: 구운 자색고구마 큐브(정과 광택) + 고구마 무스 로제트 + 크림 + 꿀 + 시나몬

geometry.silhouette: 3단 두툼 스택(약 2.5cm/장), 돔 윗면, 부푼 둥근 가장자리, 손으로 놓은 오프셋, 높이≈폭의 60%, 프레임 폭 65% 점유. 토핑은 전부 윗면에 얹힘(반죽에 박지 않음).
geometry.body: Three thick, tender pancakes stacked with a small, casual offset, as if placed by hand rather than aligned by a machine — the middle one shifted a little to the right, the top one a little back. Each pancake is a plump, pillowy round about 2.5 cm thick with a gently domed top and a soft rounded edge that bulges slightly outward where the batter rose in the pan; the stack is about 60% as tall as it is wide and occupies roughly 65% of the frame width, leaving generous empty background around it. The top face of each pancake is griddle-browned in a soft, blotchy, uneven gradient — warm caramel brown (#B9793F) at the centre where it sat longest on the hot pan, fading through toasty golden (#CF9455) into light golden (#D9A76B) toward the rim, with a few slightly darker freckles and one paler patch where a bubble lifted the batter, the way real pancakes never brown evenly. The side wall of every pancake is the pale cream of the risen crumb (#F1DDB0): a soft, spongy band with a fine open crumb texture, tiny irregular air pockets catching the light, meeting the browned top in a soft blurred edge rather than a hard line. A few tiny pinprick pores sit near the rim of the top pancake, barely visible. Where the pancakes touch, the top one presses very slightly into the one below, so the edges kiss softly instead of floating. The whole stack looks warm, tender and freshly flipped — the honest irregularity of a handmade bake.

toppings.label: WHIPPED CREAM
toppings.text: One soft dollop of lightly whipped cream (#FFF8EC), spoon-dropped, sits slightly off-centre toward the front-left of the top pancake — rounded peaks, gentle folds, a matte velvety surface, its lower edge relaxing into a soft skirt against the warm pancake.

toppings.label: SWEET POTATO CUBES
toppings.text: About six cubes of roasted purple sweet potato (#7A4E96), each roughly 1.5 cm but cut a little unevenly and sitting at its own angle: two resting on the cream, three piled against its base on the browned pancake, one alone near the rim. Their cut faces show the dense, slightly fibrous violet flesh; their outer faces are darker where they roasted, with caramelised edges turning a warm amber-brown (#B06A2C), and all of them carry a light glossy coat of the honey they were tossed in, so their edges catch the light while their cut faces stay softly matte.

toppings.label: SWEET POTATO MOUSSE
toppings.text: Beside the cream, one small piped rosette of sweet potato mousse — a pale, dusty violet (#B08FC4) with a faint fibrous grain in its ridges rather than a perfectly smooth cream — piped in a loose swirl that leans slightly to one side, the way a hand-held bag leaves it.

toppings.label: HONEY AND FINISHING
toppings.text: A thin drizzle of clear golden honey (#D9A441) traced over the cubes and the cream, translucent and glossy, spilling over the front edge into two slow drips of different lengths down the pale side walls. A soft dusting of ground cinnamon (#9A5B34) over the cream and the near rim, heavier in one spot where the shaker paused. Two halves of a toasted pecan (#9C6B3E) tucked between the cubes at different angles. The toppings gather toward the front-left so the browned pancake surface stays visible on the opposite side, and the composition reads as one deliberate, appetizing arrangement — realistic portion size, no duplicate identical elements.
